learning_outcomes.text: Solve convective heat transfer problems in ducts

syllabus_topics: Balance equations governing heat and mass transfer
Main numerical methods employed to solve balance equations
Procedure to obtain dimensionless balance equations
Solving stationary/transient conduction problems numerically using MATLAB
Solving forced convection in ducts and thermal entrance regions problems numerically using MATLAB
Solving forced and natural convection in fluid saturated porous media problems numerically using MATLAB
Solving flows around obstacles problems numerically using MATLAB
Solving convection of non-Newtonian fluids problems numerically using MATLAB
Solving dimensionless balance equations using MATLAB's PdeTool
Solving dimensionless balance equations by writing a simple MATLAB code

assessment_methods.method: Numerical solution of a basic heat and mass transfer problem

assessment_rules: The exam consists of numerically solving a basic heat and mass transfer problem. To pass, the student must be able to obtain the dimensionless form of the local balance equation, auxiliary conditions, and geometry, and solve the problem numerically in its dimensionless form. The exam is carried out online using the EOL platform. The mark will be recorded four days after communication, unless the student sends an explicit email requesting to refuse the mark.
